dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped dark perimeters with sharp outer boundaries and lighter, speckled interiors, concentrated in the central and posterior-lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of localized dark pixel aggregates lacking internal gradients, distributed primarily between larger annuli and along the lower lateral boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of three prominent macro-annuli in the mid-right quadrant form an obtuse triangular relationship, with secondary linear groupings of dark blobs extending toward the posterior.
